ops.title: Migrate fleet stores to cc-transcript v14.3 ASYNC composition (cc-steer composition, captain-hook async end-to-end)

ops.description:
DIRECTION REVERSED by the user on 2026-07-19: the store tier goes natively ASYNC in v14.3.0 (async Rust actor engine + async Python exposure) — the previous async→sync framing of this task is dead. Do NOT execute the old sync migration.

v14.3.0 (in flight) ships: mining.FeedbackStore as a final ASYNC composition facade (frozen StoreSchema config unchanged in shape; `async with store.transaction()`; every method awaitable; `await FeedbackStore.open(...)` + `async with store:`); CorrectionLog async (+ new close/async CM); DecisionLog/HeartbeatLog async (stdlib ConnectionActor, Go co-writer DDL bytes unchanged); Watcher async tick + stream. TransactionConflictError raise-on-conflict semantics survive.

Downstream rewrites:
- cc-steer (v13 async idioms — the easy direction): subclass→composition on the async API. TRIAGE_DDL dies (engine renders the verdict table from StoreSchema verdict_table='triage', accepted_column='is_steering', summary_column='what_claude_did'); DROP+CREATE views → extra_ddl; event_filter="e.quarantined_reason IS NULL" replaces the query forks (QUARANTINE_ELIGIBLE stays distinct domain SQL); +origin_path/+quarantined_reason via event_columns; the paged unjudged OFFSET loop copy dies (platform owns it); aiosqlite dropped; open_readonly → the facade readonly flag. CallableReviewFormat callables stay.
- captain-hook: ASYNC END-TO-END (user decision — resident-daemon direction): review subsystem (store/scan/announce/pipeline/dashboard/notify/fix + cli command bodies) async throughout, asyncio.run at hook-dispatch entries; ReviewStore composes db: FeedbackStore + StoreSchema (6 extra tables, 7 ColumnMigrations, busy_timeout_ms=0 announcer knob); async decisions/heartbeats call sites; drop the HeartbeatLog.events_seen test usage.
- Fleet test cleanup: cc-steer tests/test_formats.py regex_review_comments/group_value/int_group imports.
- Contract safety net: cc-transcript tests/test_store_contract.py carries the pinned behaviors (refresh_summary limit=0 divergence, TransactionConflictError, migration re-check-inside-txn) through the async flip with identical assertions.

Pin >=14.3,<15 after the v14.3.0 release. cc-sentiment and cc-context/bench: zero persistence-tier imports — no-ops.
